description:
IRREVERSIBLE: Remove a payment method

Removes a stored card or other payment method from your account. This cannot be undone: to use it again, add the card again in the dashboard. Refused with 400 for your default method and for your only method; make another one the default with `set_default_payment_method` first. `paymentMethodId` is an `id` from `list_payment_methods`.

confirm.description: Leave out on the first call. EchoCall then answers with a confirmation value. Ask the user for a clear yes, then repeat the call with the same arguments and this value.

name: remove_payment_method
title: Remove a payment method
